rusGuslar.onVisitedMessage: The sound of music brings you to a small garden, where you see an old man sitting on a stone and playing something on his instrument. "I have nothing for you. Please come back next week."

rewards.message: The sound of music brings you to a small garden, where you see an old man sitting on a stone and playing something on his instrument. "Friend, isn't the sound of music simply great? If it wasn't, you wouldn't come to me. Here, take a gift from me, and return here next week to hear more of these wonderful sounds!"
